lessons.title: Similarity and Enlargement

explanation_sections.title: Similarity and Enlargement
explanation_sections.body:
Similar shapes have equal corresponding angles and proportional corresponding sides. An enlargement
changes size by a scale factor. Lengths scale by k and areas by k².

lessons.source_reference: ElimuQuest Mathematics Curriculum Draft v1, PDF p. 14
lessons.author: ElimuQuest

questions.prompt: Enlarge triangle sides 3 cm, 4 cm and 5 cm by scale factor 2.
Similar rectangles have corresponding lengths 6 cm and 15 cm. Find scale factor from smaller to larger.
A shape has area 12 cm². Find area after enlargement by scale factor 3.
Explain scale factors greater than 1 and between 0 and 1.
questions.correct_answer: Greater than 1 enlarges; between 0 and 1 reduces.
